title: 第13章 扶摇皇朝龙卫第14章 你看你又急了
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 姬扶摇笑了笑。
陆玄的样子她看在眼里，就是一个强者姿态！
一时间。
陆玄在姬扶摇心中的地位又提升了很多！
这时，陆玄说道，“嗯……不错，饭菜口感有提升。”
姬扶摇脸色一红，认真说道，“我会继续努力的！”
经过方才的顿悟，姬扶摇觉得自己在这三天时间，实力还能再次提升！
吃完饭后，姬扶摇回到洞府继续修炼。
她盘膝而坐，意念一动，身上散发出淡淡的神华，一圈圈灵火不断在她的四周流转，如同流水一般。
拜入青玄峰之后，她的修炼可谓一日千里！
看来她的计划需要提前一些了。
姬扶摇早已经决定好，在踏入玄宗境之后，会离开大道宗寻找旧部，开始准备扶摇皇朝崛起一事。
只是她没想到不到一个月，就踏入了玄宗境！
比计划中来得早了太多！
上一世在扶摇皇朝大危之时，姬扶摇做出了壮士断腕的行动，将扶摇皇朝的三股强大力量分割，让他们保存住了大部分精锐，逃离了那场浩劫。
那个时候，她早就知道，死战是没有用的！
只能卷土重来，东山再起！
姬扶摇的纤纤玉手伸出，掌心之中出现了一个无比苍古的令牌。
正是扶摇令！
三千年前，她早已告诉了三大旧部，等到转世成功，会利用扶摇令召唤他们！
此乃信物！
这个苍古令牌呈现金黄色，上面流转着金黄色的道纹，雕刻着“扶摇”两个上古大字，一道道璀璨的纹路涌动着，令牌之中布下了恐怖的封印禁制，封印了扶摇皇朝的龙脉之力。
姬扶摇意念一动，苍古令牌飘起，一丝无比微弱的龙力浮现。
姬扶摇的娇躯微微一颤。
这熟悉的感觉！
“南荒，我扶摇女帝又回来了。”
姬扶摇缓缓开口，眼中出现睥睨之色，无比高远，那种高高在上的女帝之气涌现。
很快，姬扶摇心中有了谋划。
等到内门试炼之后，她就去接一个大道宗的内门任务，外出联系旧部。
她要联系的第一个旧部就是她的龙卫！
龙卫！
这些人对她绝对忠心耿耿，无一不发出天道誓言追随与她。
姬扶摇知道，三千年来，他们都在等她归来的消息。
至于其他两大旧部，可以让龙卫去联络。
龙卫办事，她绝对放心！
念及此。
姬扶摇直接利用上古秘法催动了扶摇令。
content_en:
Ji Fuyao smiled.
She could see Lu Xuan's appearance as that of a strong man!
For a while.
Lu Xuan's status in Ji Fuyao's heart has improved a lot!
At this time, Lu Xuan said, "Well...not bad, the taste of the food has improved."
Ji Fuyao's face turned red and she said seriously, "I will continue to work hard!"
After the epiphany just now, Ji Fuyao felt that her strength could be improved again in these three days!
After eating, Ji Fuyao returned to the cave to continue practicing.
She sat cross-legged, and with a thought, a faint divine energy emitted from her body, and circles of spiritual fire continued to flow around her, like running water.
After joining Qingxuan Peak, her cultivation has made rapid progress!
It seems that her plans need to be moved forward.
Ji Fuyao had already decided that after entering the Xuanzong realm, she would leave Daozong to look for her old subordinates and start preparing for the rise of the Fuyao Dynasty.
But she didn't expect that in less than a month, she would enter the Xuanzong realm!
Came much earlier than planned!
In the last life, when the Fuyao Dynasty was in crisis, Ji Fuyao took the action of cutting off the arms of a strong man, dividing the three powerful forces of the Fuyao Dynasty, allowing them to save most of their elites and escape the catastrophe.
At that time, she had long known that fighting to the death was useless!
We can only make a comeback and make a comeback!
Ji Fuyao stretched out her slender hand, and an extremely ancient token appeared in her palm.
It’s the Fuyao Order!
Three thousand years ago, she had already told the three old minions that when her reincarnation was successful, she would use the Fuyao Order to summon them!
This is a token!
This Canggu Token is golden in color, with golden Taoist patterns flowing on it. The two ancient characters "Fuyao" are engraved on it. The bright lines are surging. There are terrifying seals and restrictions in the token, sealing the power of the dragon veins of the Fuyao Dynasty.
With a thought from Ji Fuyao, the Canggu token floated up, and an extremely weak trace of dragon power emerged.
"Well..."
Ji Fuyao's delicate body trembled slightly.
This familiar feeling!
"Nanhuang, I, Empress Fuyao, am back again."
Ji Fuyao spoke slowly, with a look of disdain in her eyes. She was extremely lofty, and the aura of a superior empress emerged.
Soon, Ji Fuyao had a plan in mind.
After the inner sect trial, she went to take on an inner sect mission from the Dao Dao Sect and went out to contact the old department.
The first old subordinate she wants to contact is her Dragon Guard!
Dragon Guard!
These people were absolutely loyal to her, and all of them made an oath of heaven to follow her.
Ji Fuyao knew that for three thousand years, they had been waiting for news of her return.
As for the other two old ministries, Long Wei can be contacted.
She can absolutely rest assured that Long Wei is doing things!
Think of this.
Ji Fuyao directly used the ancient secret method to activate the Fuyao Order.
title_en: Chapter 13: Fuyao Dynasty Dragon Guard Chapter 14: Look, you are in a hurry again
